implementation.targetScope: composeRefs and useComposedRefs for React 19 callback/object refs, cleanup callbacks and stable hook identity. No copied upstream runtime.

changes: Allocate cleanup storage only for callbacks that return cleanup functions.
Idempotent, reentrant-safe cleanup completes all refs before propagating the first thrown error, including non-Error values.
Memoize composition when participating hook refs are unchanged.
React 19 peer only; no other runtime dependencies. Current 1.1.5 and app 1.1.2 controls are pinned.
